name: miki-webbridge
description: Control your real browser (with your login sessions) from Miki Code via the local Miki Browser Extension daemon — navigate, click, type, read pages, and screenshot any website.
author: Mymoon AI

interface.shortDescription: Control your real browser from Miki Code — navigate, click, type, and screenshot
interface.longDescription:
Miki Browser Extension lets AI control the user's real browser — navigate, click, type, read, screenshot, and interact with any website using the user's actual login sessions. The skill talks to the local daemon (http://127.0.0.1:10086 by default), which drives Chrome/Edge through a browser extension over CDP. Everything runs locally; login state and page content never leave the device.

Requires the Miki Browser Extension daemon and browser extension: https://www.miki.com/en/products/miki-browser-extension
